Subject: Mutual action plan kickoff — POC environment items (keys, org, allowlist, peering)

Thanks again for the meeting this morning — great alignment. I pulled together a concise MAP focused on the POC environment tasks so we can lock the activation week. TL;DR proposed POC runway: July 12 -> July 23 (evaluation window).

Key POC environment items I need from OrthoTech to start provisioning:
- API key provisioning model: ephemeral per-team or long-lived service key? (We recommend ephemeral scoped service accounts)
- Org seed: preferred admin user(s) for the Redwood org (email addresses)
- IP allowlist: list of egress IP CIDRs for your cluster so we can add to our ACL; if you prefer VPC peering, include the VPC CIDR and peering contact
- VPC peering details: desired region (us-west-2 / us-east-1), VPC CIDR, route table owner (NetOps contact)

Attached: MAP-OrthoTech-v0.3.xlsx (milestones), network-allowlist-template.csv (fillable). Please reply with owners and rough ETA for each item; I’ll lock dates after we have owners.

Action I propose this week:
1) OrthoTech: reply with NetOps contact + preferred peering option (by Thu 7/2)
2) Redwood: create org scaffold and issue initial scoped API keys (once we have owners)
3) Joint: schedule peering prep call if peering chosen (target Mon 7/6)

If easier, we can do a 20-min alignment call tomorrow.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi team — quick technical notes from the ops side on API keys and org setup so you can pass to Security/NetOps:

- API keys: we will issue scoped, ephemeral keys by default (30-day TTL) tied to a Redwood service account. For CI use-cases we can provide a long-lived service credential stored in your vault, but we recommend ephemeral for evaluation.
- Org scaffold: we’ll create an org with two admin seats (Priya, Sam) and a ‘poc-engineering’ team. We’ll add an audit log stream to your S3 bucket if you want logs retained off-platform for the evaluation.
- IP allowlist: if you still need to open egress, use the template CSV — list /24s where possible. For peering we only need the VPC CIDR and the peer VPC id so we can coordinate route propagation.

Attached: short SOC2 Q&A and the service account guide Marcus attached. If Security needs an on-call walkthrough, I can join a 30-min call on Mon 7/6 at 11am PT.

Cheers,
Rachel
Principal PM, Product Ops, Redwood
[Attachment: SOC2-eval-onepager.pdf]
